newsitem.title: USA: Global Knowledge Network buys American Research.
newsitem.headline: Global Knowledge Network buys American Research.

text.p: Global Knowledge Network Inc said Tuesday it bought the American Research Group, a privately held internetworking training company based in Cary, N.C.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. It is expected to boost Global's revenues to more than $200 million in 1997, the company said.
Global, which also is privately held, provides technical education services to Microsoft Corp, among other clients.
